note: The tags gate's exceptions (tools/src/gates/check-tags.ts reads it; nothing generates from it). An entry excuses the facet findings — tags out of facet order, no topic, more than one topic — of the pages its match names, and nothing else: a tag outside the list, a count outside 2-5 or a block list still fails. An entry is { name, match, reason, owner, since }: match is an exact path or a whole-path glob under docs/. The list exists for the P3b retag (plans/harness-optimize.md): each entry is one editorial batch of pages the facet split left without exactly one topic, and the batch deletes its entry when its pages pass — the gate fails an entry that excuses nothing. It ships empty once the retag lands. Edit this file, then run: make gate G=check-tags && make gate G=check-json.
